title: Indena | Berbevis®
abstract:
Indena’s Berberine Indena Phytosome™ has emerged as the top ingredient for the Botanicals category at the 8th NutraIngredients-USA Awards. Hosted annually by NutraIngredients.com, this prestigious event honors innovation and excellence across the global nutrition and dietary supplements industry.  
This recognition affirms our dedication to harnessing the best of nature through rigorous science, delivering clinically backed solutions like Berbevis®, designed to support today’s most pressing health needs with proven efficacy and superior absorption.  
For centuries, plants from the *Berberis* genus have been widely used in traditional Asian medicine for their health benefits; among them, a particular species – *Berberis aristata* – is also mentioned in the Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India.  
From a scientific point of view, berberine is recognized as a natural bioactive alkaloid obtained from plants belonging to the Berberis genus, proven to favorably modulate blood profiles such as plasma lipids and glucose levels, contributing to metabolic wellbeing, and supporting hormone balance to smooth skin imperfections.  
Finding a way to keep our metabolism balanced is one of our time’s main global health targets, as a springboard to ease parameters specific of multifactorial noncommunicable conditions (such as metabolic syndrome, Polycystic Ovary Syndrome - PCOS - or prediabetes).
This urgent need started the journey that led to Berbevis®, your natural ally for a healthy metabolism: an innovative berberine extract obtained from *Berberis aristata* with an optimized bioabsorption profile, thanks to the Indena Phytosome™ delivery system: it is in fact capable to support healthy weight management (including blood and glucose healthy metabolism and anthropometric parameter) and a healthy skin in different stages of life.  
In recent years, berberine has received widespread attention due to its good potential for optimal metabolic wellbeing during our lifespan.  
Its efficacy is linked to the berberine’s so-called *“Cloud Effect”*: its pleiotropic action that simultaneously affects both root causes (e.g. low-grade chronic inflammation, oxidative stress, gut microbiota modulation) and visible effects (e.g. insulin response) through the modulation of several cellular targets (e.g. AMPK, mitochondria, insulin-receptors, key metabolic enzymes).1  
To confirm its multi-target potential, Berbevis® has been extensively studied in *in vitro*, *in vivo* and human studies where it showed to effectively support metabolic health: favorably modulating insulin response; optimizing blood profile (leveling both glucose and lipid metabolisms); having a positive effect on body composition.2,3

Berbevis® is the perfect ally to maintain healthy blood lipid and glucose profiles.  
Berbevis® has also a positive effect on women with PCOS, resulting in an ameliorated healthy inflammatory response and better skin appearance.  
Berbevis® positively modulate body composition (anthropometric parameters and fat/muscle ratio).  
Berbevis® shows a better bioabsorption profile and an optimized gastrointestinal tolerability thanks to a custom Indena Phytosome™ formulation.  
Berbevis® has a pleiotropic effect on several pathways involved in regulating metabolism balance.  
Berbevis® well tolerated and safe, even for prolonged use.  
Berbevis® is supported by a no-interactions human study with common pharmacological therapies.
